outlook.statement: The future is not something we are waiting for. It is something we are, quietly and meaningfully, building together. Projects are in full gear and will offer an elevated standard of living, thoughtfully designed, globally benchmarked, and built with intention.

The future of the real estate industry in India holds both challenges and opportunities shaped by economic trends, regulatory reforms, technological advancements, and changing consumer preferences. A report by Concorde outlines a robust CAGR of 9.2% for the real estate sector from 2023 to 2028.
India's co-living market is expected to grow at a 17% CAGR, reaching nearly $40 billion within five years.
India's fractional ownership market is valued at $500 million today and is projected to exceed $5 billion in AUM by 2030—a tenfold growth trajectory.
The Company remains committed to harnessing the full potential of GIFT City and other emerging zones to deliver innovative, future-ready real estate solutions.

The Company believes that every Indian should have access to real estate as part of their investment portfolio, and that tokenization enables investors to participate in developments with as little as one square foot in digital ownership.
